metadata.description: Q's plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Docs: https://github.com/FunnyQ/cc-plugins#readme

plugins.name: monitor
plugins.description: Usage dashboard and live session cockpit for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Interview-driven planning, from captured intent to executed task trees.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Delegate a task to the codex, opencode, or claude CLI.

plugins.name: chronicle
plugins.description: Commits, PRs/MRs, releases, and ADRs from your git history.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Herdr terminal reference and cross-pane agent orchestration.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Coding rules enforced as hooks: comments must say why, not what.

plugins.name: browsers
plugins.description: Drive Firefox, Zen, Chrome, and Safari from the terminal.

plugins.name: runes
plugins.description: Switchable UI mods, toggled with /runes. First rune: Clawd, a pixel crab above the prompt. Claude Code only.
